topic: Food Chains, Food Webs, and Energy Transfer
key_concepts: Energy flows linearly from the sun to producers and then to consumers.
Producers, or autotrophs, make their own food using sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water th
Consumers, or heterotrophs, obtain energy by eating plants and animals.

First-order consumers feed directly on producers.

Producers and consumer orders make up trophic levels, or levels of energy transfer.
Apex consumers occupy the topmost trophic level.
